Indian Standard 
SPECIFICATION FOR PISTON RINGS FOR IC ENGINES 

PART II TAPER FACED COMPRESSION RINGS 
FROM 30 UP TO 200 mm NOMINAL DIAMETER 

M-RINGS 



1 . Scope — Specifies dimensions, tolerances, tangential toads and other details of M-rings (taper faced 
compression rings) from 30 up to 200 mm nominal diameter for internal combustion engines. 

2, Dimensions and Tolerances — Shall be as given m the Table 1 read along with Fig. 1 




AStiB'cFOR CHROME 
PLATED RING 60'±20) 

DETAIL A 
SHOWING CHAMFERING OF 
INTERNAL EDGES (Kl) 



FIG. 1 



TAPER FACED COMPRESSION RING 
(M-RING) 



Designation — Shall include: 

a) Type of ring, 

b) Nominal diameter c/j, 

c) Axial width /?!, 

d) Number of this standard, 

e) Material symbol, 

f) Manufacturing process, 

g) Whether inside edges chamfered Kl, and 
h) Type of coating. 

Exampie: 

A taper faced compression ring (M-ring) having a nominal diameter (/i===90 mm, axial width 
/?i-=2*5 mm, made of alloyed cast iron (A4), with inside edges chamfered (Kl) and phos- 
phate coated (P) shall be designated as: 

M-Ring 90x2-5 IS: 8422 (Part II) A4 Kl P

Note 1 — Dimensions within the parenthesis are not valid for new designs. 

Note 2 — For intermediate sizes and oversizes for reboring. the dimensions and characteristics (other than c/,) of the next smaller nominal diameter apply. 

Note 3 — Tangential force Fx values in columns 1, 2 and 3 correspond to the values of axial width h^ shown in columns 1, 2 and 3. 

♦Tangential load values are specified for material Ai only [see IS : 5791-1977 Technical supply conditions for piston rings for internal combustion engines {first rev/sion)]. For other 
materials, load factors given in IS : 5791-1977 shall be used. 



IS :8422 (Part II) -1977 

4. General Requirements — Shall be as given in IS : 5791 -1977. 

5. Marking — The rings which are to be fitted in a particular direction shall be marked with the word 
TOP' on the top sides of the rings. For other markings reference should be made to IS : 5791 -1 977. 

5.1 IS! Certification Maricing — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard is one of the series of Indian Standards on piston ring dimensions, tangential force, 
etc. IS : 5791 -1977 is a necessary adjunct to this standard which gives details of materials, surface finish, 
gap types and sizes, surface coatings, manufacturing processes, etc. 

In the preparation of this standard due consideration has been given to the prevalent sizes in the 
industry. It is recommended that for new designs, only the sizes given in this standard be used. The sizes 
given within parenthesis are non-preferred and should be avoided. 

In the preparation of this standard assistance has been derived from DIN 70911 'Piston rings for 
automotive engineering, M-rings, taper faced compression rings from 30 up to 200 mm nominal diameter', 
issued by Deutscher institutfur Normung (DIN).
